GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat 6l off 3 Wide trail, 4 Wide turn, Straightened Up 4l off, found little, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly during the early and middle stages. Approaching the  600m, when racing keenly, improved onto the heels of another rnr and had to  be shifted out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed rails trail behind Leader 2 Lengths 600m, stayed back inside but did not finish race off last 200m # did not finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped a runner, becoming unbalanced. Raced fiercely during the early and middle stages. Passing the 800m, had to be steadied when awkwardly placed on heels of a runner which shifted in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (off-side bubble cheeker off) Just a Bit Slow Out . Settled Down 9th on fence 7 Lengths @ 600m. off rail Straightening Up . wound up well , Made Good Ground late # ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Kicked by another horse behind the barriers. Passed pre-race veterinary examination.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length settled back 9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat

slow out x three-quarters. Inside Mid Field early then on heels and Checked , lost several Lengths and was about a 10L 9th 650m. railed Straightening Up Ridden Along all Clear . couldn't quicken at all, Not Knocked About final 100m # bad Check 1000m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Near the 1000m was checked severely before losing considerable ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair drifted back to last 6l off, saved ground tur, Straightened Up 3-4l off, ran on well to join lead on the line, dead heat # ran on from last

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, battled on well down the outside making good ground late # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 1000m was steadied from the heels of another runner and lost ground. At the 800m shifted out abruptly after again improving onto the heels of another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Rolled fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead). Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace until pushed to quicken =lead Four Wide on home turn. Pushed to quicken Five Wide @ 300m & pressured to hit lead @ 250m. Laid in @ 100m & grabbed in last 50m. # On-pace/tried hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in in the home straight when placed under pressure.
